html:

/blog/client-reporting-for-agencies (new)New ~1,400-word post breaking down what "client reporting" actually covers, the three ways agencies handle it today (manual spreadsheets, dashboard tools like Looker Studio/AgencyAnalytics/Whatagraph, live conversational reporting), a checklist for evaluating a client reporting tool, and an honest FAQ (including when a dashboard is still the better call). BlogPosting schema auto-generated via the existing blog pipeline.client reporting (260/mo, KD 6 — the single lowest-difficulty keyword in the entire keyword audit, flagged since kickoff as needing a page and never shipped until now) + client reporting tool, marketing agency reporting, seo agency reporting software (all P1)askarlo.app/blog/client-reporting-for-agencies

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 8+ sessions): catalog.ts still marks Meta Ads/HubSpot/MailerLite coming_soon with their own stated ETAs past due (Meta Ads is 3+ months overdue) — this blocks any further connector-matrix pages until a product-owner call flips their status or confirms the ETAs.

Needs your attention (unchanged): off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole plan, needs a human with a browser. Also unchanged: the dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04).

Ranking context: last week's pulse (2026-08-07) showed 0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked in the top 100 after the first full week of daily checks — expected for a ~5-week-old domain with 1 referring domain, but worth watching over the next couple of pulses.

Next: more blog posts remain queued with genuinely new angles — the agency-owner churn-risk piece (flagged repeatedly since 2026-07-16, still not shipped) and a dedicated "what happens to your clients' data" trust/security piece. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
